ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda pre-encryption recovery-sabotage chain (safeboot + shadow wipe + log clear)
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin.B-specific 'reboot to Safe Mode then encrypt' sequence chained with vssadmin/wmic shadow copy destruction and wevtutil log clearing on the same host within a tight window — the documented Qilin pre-encryption tradecraft, distinct from generic ransomware which rarely uses the safeboot pivot.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as tools dc(Processes.process_name) as tool_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wevtutil.exe","sc.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil cl*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=15m | where tool_count>=2 AND Processes.user!="SYSTEM" | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wevtutil.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","safeboot"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled","no"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","delete","shadows"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has "wevtutil" and ProcessCommandLine has " cl ")
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            Tools = make_set(FileName, 8),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 6),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
| where DistinctTools >= 2     // 2+ distinct recovery-sabotage tools in 15m = Qilin chain, not admin housekeeping
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\wevtutil.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith @"\powershell.exe"
| where (CommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","safeboot"))
    or (CommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled","no"))
    or (CommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","delete","shadows"))
    or (CommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
    or (CommandLine has "wevtutil" and CommandLine has " cl ")
    or (CommandLine has_all ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(NewProcessName),
            Tools = make_set(NewProcessName, 8),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 6),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where DistinctTools >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Safe Mode Reboot Pivot Before Encryption
id: 7c1f2b94-2a6e-4f3d-9e6a-qilin0safeboot
status: experimental
description: Qilin.B reboots victims to Safe Mode with networking, then executes ransomware from a registered service to bypass EDR. Detects the bcdedit safeboot flag flip, which is rare on production endpoints outside this tradecraft.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/10/23/qilin-ransomware-now-with-chrome-credential-theft/
  - https://www.halcyon.ai/blog/agenda-qilin-ransomware
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'safeboot'
  selection_bcd_recovery:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'recoveryenabled'
      - 'no'
  condition: selection_bcdedit or selection_bcd_recovery
falsepositives:
  - Helpdesk technician manually invoking Safe Mode for repair (rare; correlate with ticket)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\wevtutil.exe OR *\WEVTUtil.exe)) (@CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"wevtutil cl"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(bcdedit|vssadmin|wmic|wevtutil)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(safeboot|delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|recoveryenabled no|wevtutil cl)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=hits), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine]), min(_time, as=first_seen), max(_time, as=last_seen)])
| count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_tools)
| distinct_tools >= 2
ucs.rationale: Qilin.B is one of the very few RaaS families that pivots to Safe Mode with Networking via bcdedit before launching the encryptor — Halcyon and Sophos both flagged this as a Qilin signature in late-2024 healthcare campaigns (Synnovis et al). Pairing the bcdedit safeboot/recoveryenabled flip with shadow-copy and event-log destruction in a 15-minute window catches the full Qilin pre-encryption playbo

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Chrome credential harvester + comsvcs.dll LSASS dump combo (post-compromise looting)
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's documented 'rummage before encrypt' tradecraft: a PowerShell/script process touches Chromium 'Login Data'/'Local State' files outside the browser process, AND comsvcs.dll MiniDump is invoked against lsass.exe on the same host within 30 minutes. Sophos X-Ops attributed this exact pairing to Qilin affiliates after the Synnovis intrusion — generic ransomware crews rarely combine browser credential theft with LSASS dumping at scale.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as dump_time values(Processes.process) as dump_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*comsvcs*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*MiniDumpWriteDump*lsass*") by Processes.dest Processes.user
| join type=inner Processes.dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as cred_time values(Filesystem.file_path) as cred_paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as reader from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")) AND Filesystem.file_path="*\\User Data\\*" AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe") by Filesystem.dest
    | rename Filesystem.dest as Processes.dest]
| eval delay_sec=abs(dump_time-cred_time)
| where delay_sec <= 1800
| table dump_time cred_time delay_sec Processes.dest Processes.user dump_cmd reader cred_paths
| sort - dump_time
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let LSASSDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
             and (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("comsvcs","MiniDump")
                  or ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDumpWriteDump"))
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "lsass" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\"624\"","\"640\"")  // common lsass PIDs / handle args
    | project DumpTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, DumpUser=AccountName, DumpCmd=ProcessCommandLine, DumpProc=InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ChromeCredRead = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FolderPath has @"\User Data\"
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
         or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","Local State","sqlite","Copy-Item")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","firefox.exe",
                                            "explorer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","backgroundtaskhost.exe",
                                            "chromedriver.exe","msedgewebview2.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, CredUser=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredReader=InitiatingProcessFileName, CredReaderCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              CredFile=strcat(FolderPath, FileName);
LSASSDump
| join kind=inner ChromeCredRead on DeviceName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, DumpTime)) <= 30
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, FileTime, DelayMin, DeviceName, DumpUser, DumpProc, DumpCmd, CredReader, CredReaderCmd, CredFile
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let LSASSDump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\rundll32.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith @"\powershell.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith @"\pwsh.exe"
    | where (CommandLine has_all ("comsvcs","MiniDump") or CommandLine has "MiniDumpWriteDump")
        and CommandLine has "lsass"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, DumpUser=SubjectUserName, DumpCmd=CommandLine, DumpProc=NewProcessName;
let ChromeCredRead = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where TargetFilePath has @"\User Data\"
    | where TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")
    | where ActingProcessName !has_any ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","firefox.exe",
                                        "explorer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","msedgewebview2.exe")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime=TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, CredUser=ActorUsername,
              CredReader=ActingProcessName, CredReaderCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
              CredFile=TargetFilePath;
LSASSDump
| join kind=inner ChromeCredRead on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, DumpTime)) <= 30
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, FileTime, DelayMin, Computer, DumpUser, DumpProc, DumpCmd, CredReader, CredReaderCmd, CredFile
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:1 @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe) (@CommandLine:(*comsvcs*MiniDump*lsass* OR *MiniDumpWriteDump*lsass*))) OR (@EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\User?Data\*\Login?Data OR *\User?Data\Local?State OR *\User?Data\*\Cookies OR *\User?Data\*\Web?Data) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\msedgewebview2.exe)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(rundll32|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i regex("(?i)(comsvcs.*MiniDump|MiniDumpWriteDump)", field=CommandLine) regex("(?i)lsass", field=CommandLine))
OR
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten regex("(?i)\\\\User Data\\\\(Default|Profile)?.*\\\\(Login Data|Local State|Cookies|Web Data)", field=TargetFileName) NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|brave|firefox|opera|explorer|searchprotocolhost|msedgewebview2)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[collect([event_simpleName, ImageFileName, ContextImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName]), min(_time, as=first_seen), max(_time, as=last_seen), count(field=event_simpleName, distinct=true, as=distinct_evt)])
| distinct_evt >= 2
| (last_seen - first_seen) <= 1800000
ucs.rationale: Qilin's late-2024 affiliates were uniquely flagged by Sophos X-Ops for deploying a custom 'IPScanner.ps1' PowerShell helper that read Chromium 'Login Data' SQLite + 'Local State' DPAPI master key blob across domain endpoints, paired with comsvcs.dll MiniDump on LSASS — this dual-source credential sweep is what made the Synnovis healthcare breach so destructive (95k+ credentials harvested before en
